# Local modification to MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.1

The pinned npm archive is first verified against the published SHA512 integrity. The single performance-metrics sender to odml.pa.googleapis.com/v1/log is then replaced with a success callback without sending. The model, WASM, inference graph and Apache-2.0 license remain unchanged. This is a modified distribution, not an upstream privacy setting. The installer fails if the exact expected sender changes.
